description: Use when the user asks how the brand is doing or what is new. Returns the share of tracked AI answers that mention the brand with its date window, the change against the window before (null when it is within sampling noise or the questions asked changed too much to compare: then nothing changed), new insights since the user's last visit, and the first mention when there is one. Optional sections expose chart history, notices, waiting state, first-mention evidence or workspace wins. Uses the existing app comparison window, never an invented custom period. Marks nothing as seen. Next: parse_next_tasks for what to do; on Pro, parse_evidence for the answers behind an insight.

brandSlug.description: The brand's slug or its name. Omit it to use the workspace's own brand.
